title: Recover Valid Prior 2-RFC Assets by Exact Object Admission
objective: Inspect old repository branches and libraries, admit only exact valid scientific objects, and quarantine obsolete machinery and failed outputs.
exact_sequence: Fetch candidate objects from 2-RFC by exact commit and path.
Hash, replay, and independently inspect each object.
Do not import an old PASS label, state file, numerical output, or public-data-contaminated artifact as authority.
Treat repaired Module L as a recovery candidate at its exact verified scope only.
Classify each object: CANONICAL_PARENT, ADMITTED_SOURCE, REPLAY_REQUIRED, COMPARISON_ONLY, HISTORICAL_WARNING, QUARANTINED, SUPERSEDED, EXCLUDED.
Preserve Module L first-pass work only at its verified scope.
commit_message: Recover verified RFC assets without inheriting failures
hard_stops: required source or parent hash is missing
a public target would influence a generation decision
a claimed artifact cannot be fetched and independently verified
